messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need a single owner for the remediation work and test additions for the KV eviction tail-case. Thinking Mira can take the regression + promptset ownership.

mira: I can own the regression suite and the prompt set curation. ETA: PRs for tests and promptstore by next Fri (2025-04-11). Need someone to own the load profile and chaos harness.

jon: I’ll pair on the chaos harness + load profile. I’ll prototype a spike pattern (50->600 rps ramp) and a node partition scenario. Plan to push a draft job in 48h.

alex: Good. @tess can you make sure the regressions are wired into the canary pipeline and gate on 99.9 latency and kv-miss thresholds? We want automatic fail-stop on regressions.

Tess: Yep — can add a new job in canary-ci that runs the reg-suite and promptset evals. Question: do we gate on absolute 99.9 or relative regression vs baseline?

alex: Gate on both: absolute SLAs (99.9 < 120ms for read tail) and relative regression >10% over baseline triggers rollback.

mira: Noted. I’ll include baseline vectors for promptset and a small cohort of synthetic keys to exercise hot-keys. Also adding KV hit/miss counters to the test metrics.

jon: Chaos snippet I’ll use in the harness:
```
# spike then net partition
wrk -t12 -c300 -d60s http://canary.internal/read
sleep 30
iptables -A INPUT -s 10.0.0.0/8 -j DROP  # simulate node isolation
```
Will add proper infra-safe tooling instead of raw iptables in the repo.

sam: Filing a follow-up ticket to track owners/timeline so execs can see progress. Ticket: INF-4821 linked to PM postmortem.

ops-bot: Created INF-4821: "KV eviction regression & chaos harness" assigned to mira, due 2025-04-11.

tess: For CI cadence, propose: nightly full regression + promptset eval, canary-run on every deploy, and weekly longer load run. Thoughts?

alex: Agree. Nightly for fast feedback, canary for deploy safety, and weekly soak to catch slow-burn regressions. Add alerts to #incidents if nightly fails 3x in a row.

mira: Will add doc in docs/regressions/kv-eviction.md with test matrix, promptset examples, and expected metrics. Also list rollback playbook and who to page.

jon: I’ll also create a chaos drill checklist for oncall: steps to run harness, how to interpret metrics, and recovery steps.

alex: One last thing — recurring pattern detection: can we add an automated check that scans incidents for KV tail patterns and tags similar incidents so we know recurrence? @sam can you add to backlog?

sam: Yup, adding as INF-4822: "incident pattern detection: kv-tail signatures". Will scope with SRE next week.

mira: OK team — I'll open the initial PRs today and tag reviewers. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
